[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Color/Legends|red]] '''Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] during a [[Mission to the Valsedian asteroid belt|mission]] in the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] brought it to the Valsedian belt after ferrying it inside the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. With his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] socket, Skywalker destroyed a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] by outmaneuvering several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], forcing them to crash directly into the structure.
